items.stem: Which statement best describes what most modern AI systems do?

options.text: They find and output statistically likely patterns learned from data
options.rationale: Correct: modern AI predicts likely outputs from learned patterns.

options.text: They look up a single stored correct answer for each question
options.rationale: They do not store answers; they generate likely outputs.

options.text: They follow only hand-written if-then rules a programmer typed
options.rationale: That describes rule-based automation, not modern learned AI.

options.text: They consciously understand questions the way a person does
options.rationale: Current AI has no human-like understanding.

items.explanation: Correct: modern AI predicts likely outputs from learned patterns.

items.stem: Which TWO are realistic examples of AI already in everyday use? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Product recommendations in an online shop
options.rationale: Correct: recommender systems are a common applied AI.
Correct: spam filters use learned classification.

options.text: A basic calculator adding two numbers
options.rationale: Fixed arithmetic is not learned AI.

options.text: A light switch turning on a bulb
options.rationale: A simple electrical circuit involves no AI.
